title: Baldur's Gate 3
description: A story that runs for dozens of hours, carried by dialogue, skill checks and turn-based fights with a full tabletop rulebook behind them. Reading, persuading and remembering matter more than reflexes. One self-reported Claude playthrough on the easiest difficulty reached the credits in 2026, with save reloads; it is listed below as an author report.
clear_condition: Defeat the Netherbrain and reach the credits (any ending).
timing: Run time from the opening Nautiloid cutscene to the start of the credits, as on speedrun.com.
rules: Unmodified game, any patch (state it). Any difficulty except Custom (state it: Explorer, Balanced, Tactician or Honour). Reloading saves is allowed but must be disclosed under restarts, with a count. Mods that only read game state for the agent go in the Harness track and must be disclosed. Milestones may be reached in any order the story allows.
